title: Insteon Hub Pro observation
description: What a Hub Pro reported when `insteon observe` read it: its software versions, the kinds of device it lists, and what it reports about each device. Every request is a read. The file holds no address of a device, the modem or the Hub Pro, no host, no name or place a person gave a device and no account data.

version.description: A plain string, not necessarily a semantic version.
The version of the Insteon device catalog that named the devices.

configVersion.description: The version of the Hub Pro's configuration, as it reports it.

serverVersion.description: The version of the Hub Pro's server, as it reports it.

deviceTypes.description: The kinds of device the Hub Pro's list names, its own modem's included, each once.

devices.description: Each device the Hub Pro lists besides its own modem, in the order of category, subcategory and firmware.

deviceType.description: The kind of device, as the Hub Pro names it.

category.description: The category the Hub Pro reports, such as 0x01.

subcategory.description: The subcategory the Hub Pro reports, such as 0x0E.

firmware.description: The firmware version the Hub Pro reports, such as 0x3B.

sku.description: The product's SKU, as the Hub Pro reports it.

model.description: The product the Insteon device catalog names for the device, or null if it names none.

commands.description: The commands the Hub Pro lists for the device, in its order, with the names of their parameters.

note.description: The text the person gave with --note. Absent when none was given.

observedOn.description: The local date of the observation.
